summary: Saskatchewan tower site in the Meadow Lake District, added to the fire detection system in 1952. No height, staffing or present condition is in the sources read.

facts.design: Tower with windcharger, radio and cabin (1952 addition)

events.note: New tower added to the fire detection system at Onion Lake in the Meadow Lake District, per the DNR annual report for 1952-53

evidence.supports: New tower added at Onion Lake in 1952, with windcharger, radio and cabin, Meadow Lake District
evidence.quote: Another new tower, complete with windcharger, radio and cabin, was added to the fire detection system at Onion Lake in the Meadow Lake District.

evidence.supports: Source for the entry is the DNR annual report for 1952-53
evidence.quote: Department of Natural resources Annual report, 1952-53

notes_for_editor: Two sources only; the 1952 addition rests on one page that compiles the DNR annual report, which was not read. The listing's notes column gives 1971 with no explanation; not used. The websiteservice.ca towermen list names no one for Onion Lake. The place name matches the Onion Lake Cree Nation, which the search results mention; no page was read tying the tower to reserve or First Nation land, so check land status before any visit. The brief's agency field is not supported by any page read (see Nelson Hill note).
